mutant.lineText: run: (_items, ctx) => new Wait({ ...(typeof ctx.params.ms === 'number' ? { until: ctx.now + ctx.params.ms } : {}), ...(typeof ctx.params.event === 'string' ? { event: ctx.params.event } : {}) }),
mutant.nextText: check: (n) => (typeof n.params?.ms !== 'number' && typeof n.params?.event !== 'string' ? [`wait node ${n.id} needs ms or event`] : []),
